principles.title: Fundamentals without AI
principles.description: DSA, aptitude and core CS are practiced without AI, so students can think on their own in tests and interviews.

principles.title: Projects with AI, the industry way
principles.description: Students build projects with AI coding assistants, the way development teams work today.

principles.title: Review and fix AI code
principles.description: Students learn to read, question and correct AI-written code, a skill companies now test.

principles.title: Honest about AI use
principles.description: Students learn when AI is allowed in tests and interviews, and how to talk about their AI use.

industrySignals.finding: Most early-career engineers in India use AI well, but engineering judgment is the biggest gap.
New hires are trained to work with AI tools and to evaluate AI-generated code.
